profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced software developer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in SQL/NoSQL Databases, Java, C#, Springboot, Rest APIs, and Angular/React. Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor of Science - BS focused in Computer Engineering from University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed responsive web applications using Angular framework, ensuring seamless user experiences across various devices and screen sizes.
Implemented RESTful APIs using C# and ASP.NET Core, facilitating efficient communication between front-end and back-end systems.
Designed and maintained database schemas using SQL Server, optimizing data storage and retrieval for high performance.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, plan project milestones, and deliver solutions on time and within budget.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Spendtrack Team( Rotation 2)      July 2022- Present 
* Worked closely with product team to groom epics and form more testable stories and follow agile methodologies 
* Created a script to post transactions 25% faster
* Ensured quick defect resolution through developing JIRA dashboards to track defects efficiently 
*Developed an internal web application to help product team manage UI rules based on different clients 
   Front-End : Embedded JS
   Backend : Node JS
   DB : PostgreSQL

Card Digital Team(Rotation 1) June 2021- June 2022

*Developed Java REST APIs using Spring, deployed onto Azure OpenShift using CI/CD pipelines, and configured proxies on API management servers
* Implemented a common validation library that reduced code by 30% and streamlined sandbox application creation by 50%
* Aided the product team by onboarding/supporting 10+ clients and identifying pain points through the clients integration journey
* Created test scripts to conduct agile testing for delivering high-quality software to the clients within stipulated timelines
positions.insights: Skills: Test Planning · PostgreSQL · Git · OpenShift · Express.js · Node.js · Quality Assurance · Object Oriented Design · API Management · API Development · User Experience (UX) · Agile Methodologies · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Azure DevOps · Technical Requirements · JavaScript · Spring Boot · Software Testing · Cross-functional Collaborations · Teamwork · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JSON · Test Cases · Communication · Java

positions.title: Validation/Application Engineer
positions.description:
• Automated finding peak to peak voltages through a python script 
• Developed a tool to find the efficiency of boost converters
• Created PCB layout for a basic use case for an IC in Altium Designer 
• Earned LabView certification 
• Participated in sales calls

positions.title: Sales Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered packaged demonstration scripts and equipment lists to the sales team
• Researched and implemented RFID technology
• Assisted sales engineers in sales calls
• Configured devices to be used as proof of concept for clients
• Created/Presented demos for WorkForce Connect and MotionWorks Asset
• Documented the process for setting up multiple proof of concepts 
• Gained virtual machine and IP networking skills

positions.title: Printed Circuit Board Tester
positions.description:
• Interpreted electrical and mechanical schematics, blueprints, and diagrams
• Tested, rebuilt, repaired printed circuit boards
• Collaborated with engineers on testing and modifying of Marine High-Frequency Battery Charger, Single Cell Battery Charger, and Ultra Capacitor Charger
• Responsible for daily project status updates to keep staff up to date on program changes and task requirements
• Operated real-time oscilloscopes, pulse generator, meters, and power supplies

projects.title: Basic OS
projects.description:
• Developed a basic operating system including support for context switching, segmented memory protection, a simple file system, scheduling, drivers for keyboard input, text output, and virtualized clock
• Tested functionality through creating unit tests for individual components of the system

projects.title: BorrowMe
projects.description:
With BorrowMe, you can easily see available products to borrow within your friend group and also outside your group without having to ask and wait on a reply that may not come.

Frontend: React.JS 
Backend: Node.JS
Databases: MySQL Server, MongoDB Atlas
Worked on a team of 4
